prompts: Create a single finished macOS app icon for circlr, an artist creative-universe and music orbit editor. A bold, optically centered circular orbit subtly open like a lowercase c, with one small solid circular satellite at the upper-right opening and a smaller inner circular orbit: clear geometric silhouette, solid pale mint mark on a neutral charcoal rounded-square tile, restrained flat design readable at 32 pixels. Output one square 1024×1024 icon with transparent corners outside the tile, generous consistent margins, no text, no letters printed as typography, no star field, no gradients, no mockup or surrounding interface.
transforms: sips resize to ten macOS icon representations; iconutil ICNS packaging
actool compiles same PNG and icon-composer.json as named Circlr asset; layout scale 1.25
selection_reason: Last exported candidate has true alpha transparency. Earlier candidate contained a baked checkerboard.

visual_qa.small_variation: Subtle texture in generated charcoal fill retained.

technical_notes: ChatGPT returned 1254x1254 instead of requested 1024x1024; source preserved and resized locally.
Legacy-only macOS 26 preview added a wide pale frame; named Icon Composer catalog resolves it.
